import { books } from '../content.config'

---
import { favorites } from '../favorites'

interface Book { slug: string, title: string, author: string, year: number, tags: string[] }

const { books, tags } = props<{ books: Book[], tags: string[] }>()
const selected = signal<string | undefined>(undefined)
const shown = memo(() => {
  const tag = selected()
  return tag === undefined ? books : books.filter(book => book.tags.includes(tag))
})
---
.filter(role="group" aria-label="Filter by tag")
  button(type="button" aria-pressed={selected === undefined ? 'true' : 'false'} onClick={() => selected.set(undefined)}) All
  for tag of tags key={tag}
    button(type="button" aria-pressed={selected === tag ? 'true' : 'false'} onClick={() => selected.set(tag)}) {tag}
ul(aria-label="Books")
  for book of shown key={book.slug}
    li
      a(href={`/books/${book.slug}`}) {book.title}
      | {' '}
      span {book.author}, {book.year}
      if favorites().includes(book.slug)
        | {' '}
        strong Favorite
EOF
cat > src/routes/contact.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { t } from 'kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import ContactForm from '../components/contact-form.kay'

const message = t.Object({
  name: t.String({ maxLength: 200 }),
  email: t.String({ maxLength: 320 }),
  message: t.String({ maxLength: 5000 }),
})

export const contact = action(message, (input, ctx) => {
  const errors = checkContact(input)

  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0)
    return ctx.fail(422, { errors })

  return { name: input.name.trim() }
})
---
head
  title Contact
h1 Contact
ContactForm
EOF
cat > src/components/contact-form.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { ActionError } from 'kay'
import { contact } from '../routes/contact.kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import type { ContactErrors } from '../contact'

const errors = signal<ContactErrors>(contact.failed()?.data?.errors ?? {})
const thanked = signal(contact.succeeded()?.data.name ?? '')

async function submit(event: SubmitEvent) {
  event.preventDefault()
  const form = event.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement
  const fields = new FormData(form)
  const found = checkContact({
    name: String(fields.get('name') ?? ''),
    email: String(fields.get('email') ?? ''),
    message: String(fields.get('message') ?? ''),
  })

  errors.set(found)
  thanked.set('')

  if (Object.keys(found).length > 0)
    return

  try {
    thanked.set((await contact(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
    form.reset()
  }
  catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ActionError)
      errors.set((error.data as { errors?: ContactErrors } | undefined)?.errors ?? {})
    else
      throw error
  }
}
---
if thanked
  p.success(role="status") Thanks, {thanked}! Your message has been sent.
form(action={contact} novalidate onSubmit={submit})
  .field
    label(for="name") Name
    input#name(type="text" name="name")
    if errors.name
      p.error {errors.name}
  .field
    label(for="email") Email
    input#email(type="email" name="email")
    if errors.email
      p.error {errors.email}
  .field
    label(for="message") Message
    textarea#message(name="message")
    if errors.message
      p.error {errors.message}
  button(type="submit") Send
EOF
